issues.problem: CURRENT 16–17 substitutes prominent stacked rails and heavy framing for the source’s slender white enclosure and fine mesh gallery guards. This obscures the recessed glazing and overwhelms the otherwise comparable massing.
issues.action: Locally reduce the visible frame and rail sections, apply the source’s light finish, and replace coarse horizontal guard infill with fine mesh where shown. Preserve the gallery positions and ramp slopes.

issues.problem: CURRENT 18 shows circular floor openings without surrounding guards, while SOURCE 4 shows continuous cylindrical mesh protection. The existing guarded opening does not resolve the exposed openings elsewhere.
issues.action: Match the source-backed opening locations and fit continuous mesh guards around their exposed perimeters, seated on the floor and connected at their returns.

issues.problem: SOURCE 4 shows a pale floor and large curved translucent curtain divisions beneath the timber ceiling. CURRENT 18 instead has an uninterrupted brown floor and lacks those prominent spatial divisions.
issues.action: Change the upper floor to the observed pale finish and add the visible curved curtain tracks and translucent hanging panels. Retain the concave timber ceiling.

independent_review.assessment: SOURCE 1–2 establish the ramp end and adjoining long facade: a recessed building frame, three descending ramp flights, projecting galleries, a transparent upper enclosure and a raised concave timber roof. SOURCE 3 shows the glazed entrance and gallery underside; SOURCE 4 shows the curved timber ceiling, pale floor, curtain divisions and guarded circular openings. SOURCE 5 and 8 show stepped interior floor levels and substantial voids; SOURCE 6 separates the structural layers; all three SOURCE 7 plans show distinct floor arrangements. CURRENT captures the principal exterior composition, but its enclosure reads substantially heavier and its upper interior remains incomplete. The uncut section views and roof-occluded plan cannot establish whether the concealed floor arrangements match. No numerical dimensions were supplied, and screenshots alone cannot certify concealed joints.
